kernel-and-user-space.title: Opening a CSV crosses a controlled boundary
kernel-and-user-space.summary: An application requests I/O; the kernel mediates access to the filesystem. This relationship is not a literal performance trace.

nodes.label: Kernel
nodes.description: Checks access and mediates filesystem/device operations.

nodes.label: CSV file
nodes.description: Persistent bytes reached through a filesystem.

steps.title: Read request
steps.explanation: User-space application requests file data. Checks access and mediates filesystem/device operations.

steps.title: Filesystem access
steps.explanation: Checks access and mediates filesystem/device operations. Persistent bytes reached through a filesystem.

steps.title: Returned bytes through kernel
steps.explanation: Persistent bytes reached through a filesystem. User-space application requests file data.

streams-and-pipelines.title: Keep the report separate from diagnostics
streams-and-pipelines.summary: Standard output carries report data while standard error carries diagnostic evidence. A pipe joins stdout to the next program stdin.

nodes.label: Importer
nodes.description: Produces structured data and separate errors.

nodes.label: Diagnostic log
nodes.description: Failure category stays outside the report.

steps.title: Stdout
steps.explanation: Produces structured data and separate errors. Consumer reads only valid data.

steps.title: Stderr
steps.explanation: Produces structured data and separate errors. Failure category stays outside the report.

process-lifetimes.title: A parent owns the child lifetime
process-lifetimes.summary: A launched child either completes within the bound or hits a timeout. Direct-child cleanup does not prove descendant cleanup.

nodes.label: Deadline exceeded
nodes.description: Timeout requires cleanup and a failure result.

steps.title: Launch
steps.explanation: Launches an explicit argument list. Produces bounded example output.

steps.title: Finishes
steps.explanation: Produces bounded example output. Status and streams collected.

steps.title: Deadline reached
steps.explanation: Produces bounded example output. Timeout requires cleanup and a failure result.

namespaces-and-cgroups.title: Resource view and resource budget are different
namespaces-and-cgroups.summary: A container process sees namespace-specific resources and belongs to an accounting/limit hierarchy. Neither alone establishes full security.

steps.title: Resource visibility
steps.explanation: Executes using host kernel mechanisms. Control selected resource views.

steps.title: Resource accounting
steps.explanation: Executes using host kernel mechanisms. Account for and constrain resources.

steps.title: Kernel mechanism
steps.explanation: Control selected resource views. Enforces applicable mechanisms and policies.

steps.title: Kernel mechanism
steps.explanation: Account for and constrain resources. Enforces applicable mechanisms and policies.
